description: 车腾挪c5，攻击黑后同时清开g列
explanation_en: The rook clears the g-file while attacking the black queen on c4.

intro.popup: 💡 腾挪：白车在g5。车腾挪到c5，能攻击黑后c4同时清开g列吗？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Clearance: White's rook is on g5. Can it move to c5 to attack Black's queen on c4 while clearing the g-file?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rc5！车腾挪攻击黑后——Ne8被迫，Rxc4换后，Ne3赢子！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rc5! clears the g-file while attacking the queen. After ...Ne8, Rxc4 trades queens, and Ne3 wins material.

moves.popup: 白车Rc5！从g5腾挪到c5，直接攻击黑后c4，同时清开g5！
moves.popup_en: Rc5! The rook moves from g5 to c5, attacking the queen on c4 and clearing the g-file.

moves.popup: 黑马Ne8——撤退，黑后c4暂时守住，但被动！
moves.popup_en: The knight retreats to e8. Black's queen on c4 is temporarily defended, but Black is passive.

moves.popup: 白车Rxc4！吃掉黑后——腾挪获得重大收益！
moves.popup_en: Rxc4! White captures the black queen; the clearance has yielded a major gain.

moves.popup: 黑车Rxc4吃回——双方换子，但白方材料优势已确立。
moves.popup_en: The black rook recaptures on c4. The pieces are exchanged, but White has a material advantage.

moves.popup: 白马Ne3！跳入e3，攻击c4黑车——白方完全掌控！
moves.popup_en: Ne3! The knight jumps to e3 and attacks the rook on c4. White is firmly in control.
